name: ERIGERON CANADENSE
urinary_symptoms: Metrorrhagia, with violent irritation of rectum and bladder, and prolapsus uteri. Bright-red flow. Menorrhagia; profuse leucorrhœa; bloody lochia returns after least motion, comes in gushes; between periods, leucorrhœa with urinary irritation; pregnant women with "weak uterus;" a bloody discharge on slight exertion. Bleeding hæmorrhoids; nosebleed instead of menses (Bry).

source.title: ERIGERON CANADENSE - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
